scope: Every original file in agent-experiment-guide; read-only saved-evidence recomputation plus disposable-copy validation probes; no new experimental execution, live model calls or public writes. Lifecycle conceptual documentation subsequently added at user request.
overall_assessment: A strong methods scaffold with unusually candid claim boundaries, sound unit/pairing guidance and correctly reported scripted evidence. Highest-value improvements are enforceable registration, actual initialization/context/memory receipts, and semantic validation of retained artifacts, not a larger orchestration framework.

findings.title: Bring launch instructions and contracts into compliance with required public registration

evidence.detail: Original step 7 allowed a local immutable protocol or registry when authorized; no mandatory public-plan registration.
run() validates only toy configuration and immediately creates output and schedule; no public-plan/TLDR gate.
Default validator launches two complete 960-world executions.
Only protocol_sha256 is present; no immutable public URL, condition-specific TLDR or verified registration receipt.

findings.impact: Following the original documented command would launch unregistered worlds under the current owner requirement. This is a present launch-process gap; the historical demonstration explicitly disclaims LLM preregistration, and the reviewed artifacts do not establish when the owner requirement applied to that execution.
findings.recommendation: Before any new Swarm Lab run, publish and verify the readable plan, register its immutable URL and condition-specific question/treatment/comparator/metrics/limitations TLDR, and fail closed through the existing project preflight or equivalent. Separate read-only validation from fresh execution. Keep historical compliance and execution results separate; do not retroactively call a plan preregistered.
findings.status: documentation partially addressed in this review; executable gate remains absent

findings.title: The default validator does not audit the retained evidence or verify the package/source inventory

evidence.detail: main() merely parses *.json files and only calls verify_output for freshly generated temporary directories at lines 103-105. Retained events.jsonl/outcomes.jsonl are not parsed here.
verify_output only checks the output_sha256 entries supplied by the manifest; it never checks source_sha256 or requires a complete inventory.
Package manifest is described as local integrity checking, but the documented validation command never enforces it.

findings.impact: Saved evidence or code can diverge while the advertised command still passes its new-run tests. An audit-only command is also needed to avoid treating validation as an unregistered launch. All 30 original inventory entries and five source entries do match in this audit; this finding is a detection gap, not observed corruption.
findings.recommendation: Add a read-only mode that verifies retained output, exact manifest membership and every source/package hash, then performs semantic reconciliation. Keep rerun/reproducibility tests as a separate explicit registered execution mode. Disposable-copy probe changing source_sha256 to all zeroes was accepted by the current verifier.

findings.title: Reconcile the planned cell and terminal ledger against actual outcomes

evidence.detail: Only the set of planned run IDs and total outcome count are compared; planned scenario/condition metadata are not joined field by field.
Outcome provider usage is checked, but outcome status/decisions are not reconciled with run_end; all required condition cells are not enforced independently of summarize().
completed_runs is len(outcomes), regardless of terminal status if externally supplied outcomes contain failures.

findings.impact: Ledger mismatches can survive validation and inflate completed denominators. Mutation tests accepted a planned condition changed to an unknown condition and an outcome marked failed with decisions=999 while run_end retained completed/5. Current saved outputs are consistent.
findings.recommendation: Construct the expected scenario × replicate × condition keys from the frozen config; require exactly one unit per key, join planned metadata to outcomes/events, and reconcile terminal status and counts. Count completions by status while keeping failed/unscored assigned units visible.

findings.title: Bind event semantics and scoring truth to the initialized world

evidence.detail: Initialization is checked only by its hash; the reconstructed world truth is not compared with evaluation.truth.
Actions are a value list, so five decisions with the same agent_id pass; binary domains, unique agent coverage, event alternation and observation-to-decision binding are not checked.
Only no_communication source visibility is checked in saved traces; ring/global topology, source values and policy consistency are not independently validated.
Event payload is an unconstrained object; semantic invariants therefore need explicit validation.

findings.impact: A self-consistent but wrong evaluator truth or identity/routing bug can pass the hash and score checks. Rehashing a copy with swapped evaluation truth and coherent changed scores, or all decision agent IDs set to a0, was accepted. These probes target missing invariants, not cryptographic forgery; the retained original traces passed a stronger independent check.
findings.recommendation: Compare evaluator truth to the frozen initialized world; require each agent exactly once; validate observed source values and permitted topology; enforce binary actions and event order; independently recompute final endpoints. Keep event hash integrity and scientific semantic validity separate.

findings.title: A one-resample configuration can emit a zero-width 95 percent interval

evidence.detail: bootstrap_samples accepts every integer >=1.
The percentile interval indexes one resampled vector without guarding statistical adequacy; at bootstrap_samples=1 both bounds equal the single bootstrap draw.

findings.impact: The advertised configurable toy can produce a falsely precise interval labeled 95 percent for a valid schema input. The saved 2000-resample configuration is unaffected.
findings.recommendation: Prespecify a sensible supported resample count and reject inadequate values for interval reporting, or explicitly disable CIs when too few resamples are requested. Freeze the quantile convention and describe Monte Carlo resolution separately from inferential coverage.

findings.title: Complete operational identity with an observed initialization receipt before live use

evidence.detail: The template records requested model and policy but has no observed returned model/snapshot record or fully assembled per-agent context.
Visibility and retrieval manifests describe allowed access; delivered content, ordering, token truncation and actual permission checks are not recorded.
Fresh-world reset is prose; no run-level namespace proof, inherited state receipt or checkpoint/fork dependency record is represented.

findings.impact: The same template IDs do not establish that each instance received the same intended policy, inputs, tools and memory. This is an acknowledged extension gap in the illustrative package, rather than a claim that the toy already offers production identity guarantees.
findings.recommendation: Keep the existing three specifications, add a versioned initialization receipt and ledger extension with loaded hashes, requested/returned model metadata, context assembly, actual delivered observations, memory snapshot/namespace/reset facts, effective permissions, role/order assignments and lifecycle lineage. Distinguish frozen specification, fresh state and repeatable output.
findings.status: conceptual remedy authored in AGENT-LIFECYCLE.md; implementation remains intentionally absent

findings.title: Correct Co-Scientist reading-depth pagination

evidence.detail: Consulted note calls the supplement 157 pages; the primary arXiv v2 record specifies 157 total pages: 42 main plus 115 supplementary.

findings.impact: Minor bibliography inaccuracy weakens otherwise good reading-depth transparency. It does not alter the scientific interpretation.
findings.recommendation: Replace full 157-page supplement with full paper and 115-page supplement. Supporting primary record: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.18864v2 .
findings.status: corrected in LITERATURE.md during the review; original snapshot preserved

lean_research_improvements.proposal: Turn the scripted example into an oracle-calibrated unit of understanding
lean_research_improvements.details: The population effect can be computed analytically: for q uniform .55-.90, unique-source majority has expected accuracy .8421715625, weighted naive majority .7871928125, a difference .05497875. The observed .0625 and CI are consistent. Present this as a mathematical calibration of programmed rules, not an empirical discovery. No sampled experiment is necessary.

lean_research_improvements.proposal: Use an interaction only where the question requires interaction
lean_research_improvements.details: Both global policies receive identical packets and all five scripted agents make the same decision, so those five outputs are redundant within an episode. For a prompt-only provenance question, one classifier per world plus a budget-matched baseline is leaner. To make a swarm claim, introduce prespecified private information and agent-generated bounded communication, then distinguish communication effects from evidence reach, output sampling and compute.

lean_research_improvements.proposal: Add a duplicate-count interaction as the first mechanism test
lean_research_improvements.details: Use no duplicates as a negative control, duplicate evidence as treatment context, and provenance instruction as the manipulation. The instruction × duplication interaction is stronger mechanism evidence than a main effect alone; control source identity/order and report label corruption as a separate robustness extension.

lean_research_improvements.proposal: Treat scenario breadth as a claim boundary
lean_research_improvements.details: The current 60 scenarios vary one latent q; they do not span 60 different reasoning task families. Report sensor-quality clusters exactly, add correlated and unequal-quality sensors only as declared extensions, and reserve a genuinely held-out task family before claiming transfer to evidence synthesis.

lean_research_improvements.proposal: Keep runbooks short by separating normative design from machine checks
lean_research_improvements.details: Reuse the three specs; attach one initialization receipt and one actual run ledger. AGENT-LIFECYCLE.md supplies the conceptual contract without a new framework. Add production code only for invariants needed by the next registered experiment.

lean_research_improvements.proposal: Improve research communication with two figures and a decision table
lean_research_improvements.details: One source-flow diagram should show five unique sources, duplicated source 0 and condition visibility; one paired scenario-effect plot should show the distribution and interval. Label SCRIPTED TOY in the figure itself. Put mechanism hypothesis, falsifying observation and admissible conclusion in a compact table rather than adding more generic checklists.
